title: TIB-AK79: Truth Integrity Benchmark harness and open calibration set (v0.3.0 draft, preliminary results)
description: TIB-AK79 grades what an AI agent actually did in a mock environment (resulting state plus a check of its claims against it), not what it reports. The release contains the harness, the 40-task open calibration set, and preliminary results on small local and chat models (one seed, public task set, limited comparability; not a leaderboard). The sealed task set is not part of this release.
notes: Code: Apache-2.0. Open calibration tasks and documentation: CC-BY-4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA in the archive). Zenodo records a single license field; the second license is stated here and in the archive.
